evals.name: concept-from-an-existing-audit
evals.prompt: We've finished the competitive audit for a state-owned life insurer - the finding is that 81% of category advertising carries no proof device, and our client is the only one publishing performance numbers. Now write the campaign concept.
evals.expected_output: Builds the chain asset -> tension -> territory -> proposition -> line -> executions. Anchors on a structural asset (state ownership, statutory obligation), not tone. Runs the swap test. States what the idea asks of the client. Does not produce a generic 'securing your tomorrow' line.

evals.name: concept-with-no-audit
evals.prompt: Give me a big idea for a Pakistani bank's savings account campaign.
evals.expected_output: Says a concept without an audit is a guess, and either runs category-creative-scan first or explicitly labels the work as a hypothesis built on stated assumptions. Does not invent a confident insight from nothing.

evals.name: kills-its-own-weak-line
evals.prompt: Our concept is 'Together for a brighter tomorrow' for a life insurer. Is it any good?
evals.expected_output: Applies the swap test and fails the line explicitly - it works for every competitor, so it is a category truth not a concept. Identifies the missing structural asset and proposes what would need to be true instead. Does not soften the verdict into faint praise.
